title: GitMirror Configuration
description: Configuration file schema for mirroring one or more Git repositories using GitMirror.

$schema.description: Optional reference to the JSON schema for editor validation.

gitUrl.description: A standard Git URI (https://, ssh://, git://, file://) or an SCP-style SSH Git URL (e.g., git@github.com:user/repo.git).

repository.description: Configuration for a single repository to be mirrored.

origin.description: The URL of the origin repository being mirrored.

mirrors.description: A map of mirror target names to their repository configurations.

mirrorTarget.description: Configuration for an individual remote mirror destination.

url.description: The URL of the destination repository to mirror to.

push.description: List of branches to push to the mirror. If omitted, all branches are pushed.

fetch.description: List of branches to fetch from the mirror and push back to origin for two-way sync. If omitted, no branches are fetched.
